name: Pridespawn Sentinel AP
source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

items.name: Bec de Corbin
items.description: A bec de corbin is a spiked polearm that uses a hammer head to help balance the spike. The hammer portion can be used as a secondary striking surface, while the spike or fluke is specially designed to punch through armor and shields.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

generalAbilities.name: Sin Scent (Imprecise) 30 feet
generalAbilities.description:
A sinspawn can smell creatures that reflect its sin as the scent ability. The GM determines which creatures are appropriately sinful.

See rules...

Scent involves sensing creatures or objects by smell, and is usually a vague sense. The range is listed in the ability, and it functions only if the creature or object being detected emits an aroma (for instance, incorporeal creatures usually do not exude an aroma).

If a creature emits a heavy aroma or is upwind, the GM can double or even triple the range of scent abilities used to detect that creature, and the GM can reduce the range if a creature is downwind.

savenote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic, +4 status to all saves vs. mental

defensiveAbilities.name: Hallucinatory Backlash
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The pridespawn takes damage from a creature's weapon Strike

Effect The pridespawn rebuffs the arrogance of the foe that harmed it and scoffs at the attack. The triggering creature hallucinates their own attack coming back at them and takes 4d6 Mental Damage damage (Basic DC 32 Will Saving Throw save).

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: False Pride
offensiveAbilities.description:
The pridespawn sentinel stumbles back and appears frightened and intimidated by a creature within 30 feet that it can see. The targeted creature must attempt a DC 32 Will Saving Throw save; regardless of the result, that creature is temporarily immune to False Pride for 24 hours.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature becomes overconfident and careless as they believe themselves to be more intimidating than they actually are. They're Off-Guard against the next attack the pridespawn sentinel attempts against them this round.

Failure As success, but the creature's false pride causes them to become Slowed 1 for 1 round as they spend one of their actions posturing and bragging about their superiority. They're off-guard as long as they remain slowed.

Critical Failure As failure, but for 1 minute.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sinful Bite
offensiveAbilities.description:
A creature hit by the jaws of a pridespawn sentinel must attempt a DC 29 Will Saving Throw save as it's assailed by arrogant thoughts.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Sickened 1.

Failure The creature is Sickened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is sickened 2 and also Clumsy 1 and Enfeebled 1 for 1 minute.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: A pridespawn sentinel deals 1d6 extra precision damage to creatures who are Off-Guard.
